attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: 'Nearly everything' fairly renders 'pretty much every word', and the scope is limited to that week's statements on regulation. The claim is partly evaluative, because some endorsed statements are normative.

contract.note: Limiting the check to factual substance and setting aside policy preferences and forecasts is a fair, ordinary reading. The result depends on a reconstructed set of statements that the speaker never listed.

evidence.note: Original Tegmark post dated 2023-11-26, inside the period. It shows a normative preference plus some factual assertions, but it is not a full inventory and not an independent fact-check.

reviews.rationale: The packet recovers only one Tegmark post and does not check its factual assertions against independent records. The full set of statements Marcus endorsed is not established. Neither the support condition nor the contradiction condition can be assessed.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his post.

semantics.note: An unhedged 'will' with no deadline. Reading 'all of us' as worldwide reach rather than literally every person is faithful to the speaker's emphasis.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair: EU generative-AI rules causing a concrete change to a global provider's practices counts as an effect beyond the EU. It needs neither a literal effect on every person nor a narrow tie to that week's foundation-model vote.

evidence.note: Anthropic disclosure dated 2026-08-14, before the cutoff. It ties watermarking to EU AI Act compliance and says it is applied globally. As a company disclosure, it is the primary record of the company's own policy.
TechCrunch report dated 2026-08-11 independently confirms that the watermarking policy was announced to comply with EU rules.

reviews.rationale: Dated records from before the cutoff show a major provider adopting a global watermarking policy, explicitly because of EU AI Act obligations. That meets the early-resolution rule. Possible future regional scoping and incomplete rollout do not undo the documented adoption of a global policy.

semantics.note: Faithful to the description: four boxers, not boxing, none resembling the named people. The 'loser' judgment is rightly excluded.

contract.note: Judging the specific image by figure count, action, and likeness is an ordinary, fair reading.
